passages.context: The complete English constitution, including its recollection of the 1570 Missal of Pius V, its account of the conciliar foundations of the revision, the General Instruction, the three added Eucharistic Prayers and common words of consecration, the revised Order of Mass and enlarged lectionary, the hope that the Missal be received as a witness to unity in the diversity of languages, and the effective date of 30 November 1969.
passages.notes: The complete delivery was structurally inspected; no comparison with a printed Acta witness is claimed.

alternate_titles: Constitutio Apostolica qua Missale Romanum ex decreto Concilii Oecumenici Vaticani II instauratum promulgatur
Apostolic Constitution on the Roman Missal renewed by decree of the Second Vatican Council
work.author: Pope Paul VI
work.description: Paul VI's apostolic constitution of 3 April 1969 promulgating the Roman Missal renewed by decree of the Second Vatican Council, describing the revised Order of Mass, the three added Eucharistic Prayers, the common words of consecration, and the enlarged lectionary, and ordering its prescriptions into effect from 30 November 1969, the First Sunday of Advent.
work.title: Missale Romanum (Apostolic Constitution)
